executive_summary: Chairman-ordered corrective (RCA 9a02a76d) closing the output-flow blind spot (no axis measured whether origin/main is actually advancing) that let a 14.6h fleet output stall go unnoticed, plus the chairman-specified (2026-09-01) per-SD-type duration-baseline gauge, a directive-ack severity fix, and resolution of an open escalation-duty spec question.

functional_requirements.title: Output-flow gauge
functional_requirements.description: detectOutputFlowStall (lib/adam/output-flow-gauge.js) flags origin/main HEAD unchanged for >=4h while the fleet is active (never during legitimate quiescence). Wired into adam-quiet-tick.mjs as QUIET_TICK_OUTPUT_FLOW_STALL, state persisted in .adam-quiet-tick-last.json.
acceptance_criteria: A stalled HEAD while active flags.
A stalled HEAD while quiescent does not flag.
A moved HEAD resets the baseline.

functional_requirements.title: Duration-baseline gauge (chairman-specified)
functional_requirements.description: computeDurationStats/buildBaselines/classifyDurationBreach (lib/adam/duration-baseline-gauge.js) compute median+p95 per sd_type from real strategic_directives_v2 history and FLAG (never fail) an in-flight item past its type's p95, escalating on a 2nd consecutive breach tick. Wired as QUIET_TICK_DURATION_BASELINE_BREACH.
acceptance_criteria: Never breaches on an undersized (<3) or absent baseline.
Breaches only when elapsed exceeds p95.
Escalates only on a 2nd consecutive breach for the same item.

functional_requirements.title: Directive-ack severity exemption
functional_requirements.description: convergeAckTTL (lib/retention/session-coordination-ack-convergence.js) exempts payload.severity==='high' rows from the 14-day mechanical auto-ack pass.
acceptance_criteria: A severity=high row is never mechanically acked.
A non-high row is still converged as before.

functional_requirements.title: Resolve the escalation-duty open question
functional_requirements.description: Investigated whether a coordinator-to-Adam escalation duty is encoded with trigger/clock/addressee (leo_protocol_sections id=632 vs crew-comms-routing-protocol.md Rule 5) and documented the resolution directly on section 632: not a conflict, two ladders for two different triggers.
acceptance_criteria: No amendment needed to either document (verified consistent).

functional_requirements.title: Both new tokens registered in the startup-check allowlist
functional_requirements.description: QUIET_TICK_OUTPUT_FLOW_STALL and QUIET_TICK_DURATION_BASELINE_BREACH added to adam-startup-check.mjs's NO-OP-gate pipe-list, in the same change as their emission (per this repo's own quiet-tick-token-parity-lint contract).
acceptance_criteria: quiet-tick-token-parity-lint passes with 0 missing-from-consumer tokens for the adam-quiet-tick.mjs/adam-startup-check.mjs pair.

technical_requirements.title: Pure detectors, thin IO wiring
technical_requirements.description: Both new gauges follow the file's own established convention: pure, independently-unit-tested functions in lib/adam/*.js, with minimal fail-soft IO fetchers and wiring inside adam-quiet-tick.mjs's main().

test_scenarios.expected: tests/unit/ (3238 tests) shows 0 regressions attributable to this diff.

acceptance_criteria: Both new gauges deliver flag-not-fail signals per the chairman governance model (no automated verdicts on in-flight work).
Zero regressions across the fleet/coordinator/adam unit surface.
The escalation-duty open question is closed with a documented resolution, not left open.

risks.risk: The output-flow gauge could false-positive during a legitimate but unusually long lull
risks.mitigation: Gated on `quiescent` (the fleet's own existing liveness assessment) — only flags when workers are active but nothing is landing, matching the exact incident shape.

risks.risk: The duration-baseline gauge could flag on thin historical samples for a rare sd_type
risks.mitigation: classifyDurationBreach hard-gates on MIN_SAMPLE_SIZE=3; a type with fewer completions never breaches.

risks.risk: Ack-vocabulary unification and the isBreaching owe-predicate consolidation (broader parts of the RCA's directive-ack finding) were not fully implemented -- only the severity exemption
risks.mitigation: Deliberately scoped down to the single, cleanest, most testable fix per LEO Small PRs guidance; the broader refactor remains available as a documented fast-follow.

consumers: Adam's own quiet-tick cron (self-consumes its own QUIET_TICK_* output per adam-startup-check.mjs's NO-OP gate contract)
dependencies: chairman verbal specification 2026-09-01 for the duration-baseline gauge
observability_rollout: No rollout needed -- pure additive logic to an existing, already-running tick.

system_architecture.summary: Two new pure-function library modules (lib/adam/output-flow-gauge.js, lib/adam/duration-baseline-gauge.js) plus minimal wiring into the existing adam-quiet-tick.mjs main() loop, following its established detector convention exactly.

implementation_approach.summary: Already implemented and committed to the SD branch, following the file's own conventions to minimize risk in a live-critical cron script.
steps: Register new tokens in adam-startup-check.mjs allowlist
Resolve escalation-duty open question in leo_protocol_sections id=632

metadata.lead_note: Child C of orchestrator SD-LEO-INFRA-ACTIVATE-INERT-STALL-001. Broader ack-vocabulary unification deliberately deferred as fast-follow.
